egressOwner: fabric variant only: SrtShardBackend with native UDP multiplexer-port reuse.
comparison: No legacy number here by design: legacy SRT egress cannot run at N=1000 at all. Directly observed via the sibling srt-fabric-matrix harness mode at SRT_FABRIC_MATRIX_EGRESS_COUNT=1000: the legacy variant's output-creation progress froze at 512/1000 outputs and never advanced past it even after 30+ seconds (would have hit the harness's 240s timeout and failed the whole run, since the legacy and fabric variants run sequentially in one process and a legacy failure aborts before the fabric variant ever starts) -- confirming the hardcoded 512-sender-thread semaphore cap in src/media/srt_egress.rs:212 is a real, currently-hit ceiling, not just a theoretical one. This run instead targets the fabric path alone via the resource-sweep harness command with RESTREAM_EGRESS_FABRIC=srt, bypassing the matrix's paired-variant structure. Fabric reached 1000/1000 outputs cleanly in 43 seconds. mediamtx logged 2,002 'decode error' WARN lines and restream logged 1,276 'egress feed overrun: resynchronized' WARN lines -- both roughly proportional to output count versus the N=500 capture (762 and correspondingly fewer respectively), consistent with the same benign single-connection ramp-up resync mechanism, not a new failure mode at this scale. Zero panics, zero restream-side errors.
scope: Proves fabric clears legacy's hard architectural ceiling, not a legacy-vs-fabric resource comparison (there is no legacy number to compare against at this scale). Pair with the sibling vps-6cpu-12gb-n500/ capture for the highest scale at which a fair CPU/RSS comparison is possible.
deviations: Single host sample; no RcvQ/SndQ native thread-count sampling; --no-netns used (this harness mode defaults to a private network namespace, unlike the *-fabric-matrix commands, so --no-netns was passed explicitly for this run).
